changes: Kept the scribe and the date as given; expanded the notes on the corrupt words in the colophon

date.as_written: N. S. 962 (date ut supra, after the mantra)

notes: Bendall does not print the date in Devanāgarī. He says only 'date ut supra', which points to N. S. 962 = A.D. 1842 (962+880=1842, which agrees). The scribe's name has gaps in Bendall's text ('वज्रश्री ...प...कस्य'). 'हस्ताकरणस्य' is probably a corrupt form of hastākṣareṇa ('in the handwriting of'). 'चरणस्य कैवे [? एकस्विव]' is corrupt. It may stand for '…caraṇasevaka', describing the scribe as a devotee at the feet of Āryāvalokiteśvara. Āryāvalokiteśvara is a deity, so he is not listed as a person.
